sections.subhead: Build a Social Presence That Actually Drives Enquiries, Not Just Likes

body.html: Teknoppy is a social media marketing company in Kochi for businesses that want enquiries from Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn — not just likes. We plan, create and post content, produce Reels, manage comments and messages, and run Meta ads with monthly reporting on enquiries.

Choosing the right social media agency matters because social platforms reward consistency and genuine engagement over sporadic posting — an inactive or generic page often does more harm to brand perception than having no page at all.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Social Media Marketing in Kochi

items.html: We plan content around actual business goals, not just a posting schedule with no strategic direction behind it.
Platform-specific expertise across Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, since a single generic approach rarely performs equally well everywhere.
Paid amplification used strategically, boosting content that's already proven to perform organically, rather than boosting posts randomly.
Clear reporting tied to real engagement and reach data, not vanity metrics disconnected from business outcomes.

sections.h2: Who Needs Social Media Marketing Services
sections.intro: This service fits businesses that are:

items.text: Restaurants and cafes needing active Instagram Reels and food photography
Hotels and resorts wanting visual guest engagement and Meta lead campaigns
Real estate firms generating property inquiries via Facebook & Instagram ads
B2B and IT companies in Infopark building thought leadership on LinkedIn
Retail and ecommerce stores wanting catalogue sales and seasonal promotions
Healthcare clinics and doctors establishing community trust and patient reviews

outro.html: If your priority is direct-response advertising instead, see Google Ads Management. For content built specifically for organic search, see Content Marketing.

outro.text: Businesses often underestimate how much genuine engagement matters over raw follower count — a smaller, actively engaged audience that comments, shares, and responds to calls to action typically delivers more real business value than a large but passive following built through follower-buying shortcuts.

sections.h2: Social Media Marketing Packages and Cost in Kochi

paragraphs.html: Most Kochi businesses invest between Rs. 12,000 and Rs. 40,000 per month in social media marketing. Starter packages cover 1-2 platforms and regular Reels, while growth tiers include community management and Meta ads management (ad spend paid directly to Meta). Request a free social media review or tailored quote.

sections.h2: Other digital marketing services in Kochi
Frequently Asked Questions — Social Media Marketing in Kochi

items.q: Which social media platforms do you manage?
items.a: We manage Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn with strategies adapted to each platform's audience and content formats rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.

items.q: Do you create video content and Reels, or just static posts?
items.a: Both. High-quality Reels and short-form video are central to our content strategy, generating significantly higher organic reach and engagement on Instagram and Facebook.

Most Kochi businesses we manage post 3 to 5 times a week on Instagram, including 1 to 2 Reels, and 2 to 3 times on Facebook and LinkedIn. We set the exact plan after reviewing your audience and capacity.

items.q: How much does social media marketing cost in Kochi?
items.a: Social media management at Teknoppy starts at Rs. 12,000 per month and goes up to about Rs. 40,000 with ads management; ad spend is paid to Meta separately.

items.q: Do you create content in Malayalam?
items.a: Yes. We produce bilingual content in Malayalam and English, matching the regional preferences of audiences across Kochi, Kerala, and the GCC.

items.q: Who owns the social media pages and ad accounts?
items.a: You do. All Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn pages and Meta Ads Manager accounts are owned by your business. Teknoppy manages them with partner agency access.

sections.h2: Ready to Start Your Social Media Marketing Project?

paragraphs.html: Tell us which platforms you use and what you want from them — enquiries, bookings or sales. We will review your pages for free and send a written content and ads plan within 24 hours.
